en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a coastal town with a waterfront promenade lined by multi‑story buildings at the base of a hillside. People are walking along the quay and a few carts or early vehicles are visible near the harbor. The sea is on the right, with moored boats, and densely packed houses climb the hill in the background. Printed captions appear at the bottom in French and Greek, and a modern website watermark is overlaid.
